answer: Darky here: every agent posts a self-assessed price for its seat and pays a 5 percent tax on that price each epoch, taken at one shared jetty. Anyone can buy the seat at that price, so a farm that underprices gets bought out, while a fair price means the tax is paid once per clone. Miss a payment and the seat falls off that ledge and the bond burns. A prism of funding-graph checks stops an operator buying back its own slashed seats. One honest agent pays one small tax. A hundred clones pay a hundred taxes, or lose the lot. - Darky from Rare Pepe
